T57: a thread that already holds the moment cannot be tapped. Today the whole row fades (opacity 0.45), so "This moment is in it", the only reason given, reads at about 2:1.

Recommended: the title and the link mark fade; the line "This moment is in it" stays in the muted ink at 4.5:1. The row still cannot be tapped and is spoken as dimmed.

Nothing else changes: no new word, control, colour or count.
